file_write.scope: Only one new DocForge project through an owned sibling staging directory, plus explicit managed Skill installation, update, backup, and rollback paths.
file_write.reason: The requested reusable importer must publish a new verified project and support an explicit reversible Codex Skill installation without overwriting unmanaged data.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata plus explicit CLI destination and non-overwrite checks; host enforcement is external.
target_enforcement.claude: Permission metadata plus explicit CLI destination and non-overwrite checks; host enforcement is external.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata plus explicit CLI destination and non-overwrite checks; host enforcement is external.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit CLI destination and non-overwrite checks.

subprocess.scope: Local Node runtime and local docforge inspect, validate, and explicitly requested build commands using argument arrays.
subprocess.reason: The Skill delegates to one deterministic Node importer and must use the installed DocForge CLI as the real compatibility and completion oracle.
